CheckTitle: Password minimum length is at least 8
Description: Checks active password policies require a minimum password length of at least 8.
Risk: Short passwords are easier to guess, spray, and brute force.

Code.Other:
1. In the Okta Admin Console, go to Security > Authentication > Password or Security > Authenticators > Password.
2. Open the general-user password policy.
3. Set minimum password length to at least 8 characters; use a longer value such as 12 where compatible.
4. Keep username exclusion and other approved strong-password settings enabled.
5. Save and communicate any password-change impact to users.

Recommendation.Text: Set password minimum length to at least eight characters and keep strong password settings enabled for general users.

Notes: Requires the Okta read scopes documented for the referenced management APIs.
